```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
############################################################
## PURPOSE  : Preranked GSEA between RNA clusters (3 pairwise comparisons)
## INPUT    : pILC_DESeq2_all_pairwise_results_named_genes.tsv (stat column)
##            c5.all.v2025.1.Hs.symbols.gmt (GO) + msigdbr (Hallmark, Reactome)
## OUTPUT   : named_genes_only/pairwise_GSEA/
## NOTES    : Positive NES = enriched in the first cluster named.
##            Named genes only (bare ENSG IDs cannot match MSigDB).
##            Clusters were derived from the same expression data.
############################################################
```



```{r}
set.seed(42)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(fgsea)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(msigdbr)
})

# ----------------------------
# Paths (fixed names, no dates)
# ----------------------------
named_dir   <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/DESeq2/DESeq2_3clusters/pILC_DESeq2_3clusters/named_genes_only"
res_file    <- file.path(named_dir, "pILC_DESeq2_all_pairwise_results_named_genes.tsv")
c5_gmt_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/GSEA/Dataset/c5.all.v2025.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"
out_dir     <- file.path(named_dir, "pairwise_GSEA")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

for (f in c(res_file, c5_gmt_file)) if (!file.exists(f)) stop("Missing: ", f)

min_size <- 10
max_size <- 500

# ----------------------------
# Ranking data
# ----------------------------
x <- fread(res_file)
x <- x[!is.na(stat) & !is.na(gene_symbol) & gene_symbol != ""]
x[, gene_symbol := toupper(gene_symbol)]
cat("Comparisons:", paste(unique(x$Comparison), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ----------------------------
# Gene sets from databases
# ----------------------------
get_msig <- function(collection, subcollection = NULL) {
  r <- tryCatch(msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = collection, subcollection = subcollection),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(r)) r <- tryCatch(msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = collection, subcategory = subcollection),
                                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(r) || nrow(r) == 0) { message("Not available: ", collection, " ", subcollection); return(list()) }
  r <- as.data.table(r)
  lapply(split(r$gene_symbol, r$gs_name), function(g) unique(toupper(g)))
}

gmt <- strsplit(readLines(c5_gmt_file), "\t")
go  <- setNames(lapply(gmt, function(v) toupper(v[-(1:2)])), vapply(gmt, `[`, character(1), 1))

collections <- list(
  Hallmark = get_msig("H"),
  Reactome = get_msig("C2", "CP:REACTOME"),
  GO_BP    = go[grepl("^GOBP_", names(go))],
  GO_CC    = go[grepl("^GOCC_", names(go))],
  GO_MF    = go[grepl("^GOMF_", names(go))]
)
collections <- collections[lengths(collections) > 0]
if (!("Hallmark" %in% names(collections))) stop("Hallmark sets could not be loaded.")
cat("Collections:", paste(names(collections), lengths(collections), collapse = " | "), "\n")

# ----------------------------
# fgsea for every comparison and collection
# ----------------------------
results <- list()
for (cmp in unique(x$Comparison)) {
  d <- x[Comparison == cmp][order(-baseMean)][!duplicated(gene_symbol)]   # keep the most expressed per symbol
  ranks <- sort(setNames(d$stat, d$gene_symbol), decreasing = TRUE)
  first  <- sub("_vs_.*", "", cmp)
  second <- sub(".*_vs_", "", cmp)
  cat(cmp, ": ", length(ranks), " ranked genes\n", sep = "")

  for (col in names(collections)) {
    set.seed(42)
    fg <- as.data.table(fgseaMultilevel(pathways = collections[[col]], stats = ranks,
                                        minSize = min_size, maxSize = max_size,
                                        eps = 0, nproc = 1))
    fg[, padj := p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")]       # within comparison and collection
    fg[, `:=`(Comparison = cmp, Collection = col,
              Enriched_in = fifelse(NES > 0, first, second))]
    setorder(fg, padj, pval)
    results[[paste(cmp, col)]] <- fg
  }
}
all_fg <- rbindlist(results)

export <- copy(all_fg)
export[, leadingEdge := vapply(leadingEdge, paste, character(1), collapse = ";")]
setcolorder(export, c("Collection", "Comparison", "pathway", "Enriched_in", "NES", "pval", "padj"))
fwrite(export, file.path(out_dir, "pairwise_GSEA_all_collections.tsv"), sep = "\t", na = "")

cat("\nPathways with FDR < 0.05:\n")
print(all_fg[, .(Tested = .N, FDR_lt_0.05 = sum(padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(Collection, Comparison)])

# ----------------------------
# Hallmark dot plot
# ----------------------------
h <- all_fg[Collection == "Hallmark"]
keep <- unique(c(h[padj < 0.05, pathway],
                 h[order(padj)][, head(pathway, 8), by = Comparison]$V1))
subtitle_txt <- "Top 8 Hallmark sets per comparison (black outline = FDR < 0.05)"
if (length(keep) == 0) {
  keep <- unique(h[order(padj)][, head(pathway, 8), by = Comparison]$V1)
  subtitle_txt <- "No set reached FDR < 0.05; top 8 per comparison shown"
}
h <- h[pathway %in% keep]
h[, Label := tools::toTitleCase(tolower(gsub("_", " ", sub("^HALLMARK_", "", pathway))))]
lvl <- h[, .(m = mean(NES)), by = Label][order(-m)]$Label
h[, Label := factor(Label, levels = rev(lvl))]
h[, Comparison_label := gsub("_vs_", " vs ", gsub("Cluster", "Cluster ", Comparison))]
h[, minus_log10_FDR := -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-10))]
h[, Sig := fifelse(padj < 0.05, "FDR < 0.05", "n.s.")]

p <- ggplot(h, aes(Comparison_label, Label, fill = NES, size = minus_log10_FDR)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, aes(color = Sig), stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FDR < 0.05" = "black", "n.s." = "grey70"), name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0,
                       name = "NES\n(+ = first cluster)") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "-log10 FDR", range = c(2, 9)) +
  labs(title = "Hallmark pathway enrichment between RNA clusters",
       subtitle = paste0(subtitle_txt, "; positive NES = higher in the first cluster named"),
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title.position = "plot", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

h_in <- max(5, 0.3 * nlevels(h$Label) + 3)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "pairwise_GSEA_hallmark_dotplot.pdf"), p, width = 9, height = h_in)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "pairwise_GSEA_hallmark_dotplot.png"), p, width = 9, height = h_in, dpi = 300)

# ----------------------------
# README and provenance (fixed names)
# ----------------------------
writeLines(
  c("Pairwise preranked GSEA between RNA clusters",
    "Seed: 42",
    "Ranking: DESeq2 Wald statistic (positive = higher in the first cluster named); named genes only",
    "Gene sets: MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome (msigdbr), GO BP (local C5 GMT)",
    paste0("Set size: ", min_size, "-", max_size, "; fgseaMultilevel; BH FDR within each comparison and collection"),
    "Clusters were derived from the same expression data; results are not independent validation.",
    "",
    paste0("Input md5: ", unname(tools::md5sum(res_file))),
    paste0("C5 GMT md5: ", unname(tools::md5sum(c5_gmt_file))),
    paste0("fgsea ", as.character(packageVersion("fgsea")),
           " | msigdbr ", as.character(packageVersion("msigdbr")))),
  file.path(out_dir, "README_pairwise_GSEA.txt"))
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(out_dir, "sessionInfo_pairwise_GSEA.txt"))

cat("Done. Output:", out_dir, "\n")
```
